card.name: Linking words before excipients or application sites
card.fires_on: Small linking words right after "formulated" before an excipient such as polysorbate 80 or castor oil. It also fires on words like "a" or "clean" in route and application directions, such as "into a large vein" or "apply to clean, dry skin".

modes.label: After formulated
modes.description: The word "in" or "with" follows "drugs formulated" in hypersensitivity warnings, just before a solubilizer name.
modes.example: hypersensitivity reactions to docetaxel or to other drugs formulated<< with>> polysorbate 80. Se

modes.description: Partway through the word "Sterile" in a diluent name.
